versions.title: Lumi 0.1.0 Alpha
versions.summary:
Alpha 0.1.0 includes:
Project-based versions, branches, compare, restore, and recovery.
Durable quick rollback with live undo/redo for recent building changes.
Work zones, previews, tags, partial restores, and background progress.
Best-effort WorldEdit, FAWE, and Axiom capture plus dedicated-server support.
